definitions.explanation: A close emotional connection between people, often family or deep friendships.

examples.japanese: ⟦{家族|かぞく}→家族：00552_kazoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{絆|きずな}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{強|つよ}い→強い：00820_tsuyoi⟧。
{絆|きずな}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{深|ふか}める→深める：02407_fukameru⟧。
⟦{友情|ゆうじょう}→友情：03648_yuujou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{絆|きずな}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{結|むす}ばれている→結ぶ：02308_musubu⟧。
examples.english: We are connected by bonds of friendship.

notes:
{絆|きずな} refers to deep emotional bonds between people — stronger and more enduring than a casual connection. It implies a relationship forged through shared experiences or hardship.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {絆|きずな}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{深|ふか}める→深める：02407_fukameru⟧ (deepen bonds)
- {絆|きずな}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{結|むす}ぶ→結ぶ：02308_musubu⟧ (form bonds)
- {絆|きずな}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{強|つよ}い→強い：00820_tsuyoi⟧ (have strong bonds)
- ⟦{家族|かぞく}→家族：00552_kazoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{絆|きずな} (family bonds)
- ⟦{友情|ゆうじょう}→友情：03648_yuujou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{絆|きずな} (bonds of friendship)
- {絆|きずな}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (cherish one's bonds)

CULTURAL NOTE:
Became a symbolic word after the 2011 ⟦{東日本大震災|ひがしにほんだいしんさい}→東日本大震災：noentry⟧ (Great East Japan Earthquake), representing community solidarity and mutual support. It was selected as the 'kanji of the year' (⟦{今年|ことし}→今年：00722_kotoshi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{漢字|かんじ}→漢字：09480_kanji⟧) for 2011.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{繋|つな}がり→繋がり：10380_tsunagari⟧: a more general 'connection' or 'link,' not necessarily emotional
- ⟦{縁|えん}→縁：02182_en⟧: fate-based connection, the idea that people are brought together by destiny
